gui_forms::Control.summary: Control is the retained visual root and invariant owner for stable/runtime identity, hierarchy, geometry, layout transactions, initialization batching, style/theme resolution, typed invalidation, input eligibility and routing hooks, validation, binding, semantic projection, dispatch, focus, lifetime, and provider extensions.
remarks: Every control has a nonempty immutable `StableId` and a process-local `RuntimeId`; the mutable `name` is distinct from both and publishes a tokenized change event.

Requested bounds reject nonfinite or negative extents and honor retained minimum/maximum size. Reading arranged or absolute geometry may execute the declared layout read barrier; it is not a raw field read.

`invalidate(Dirty)` marks the affected control or path, `invalidate_subtree` marks every descendant, and `invalidate_declared` rejects undeclared effects in development builds. The dirty vocabulary distinguishes measure, arrange, paint, hit test, text, style, resource, semantics, and accessibility.

`begin_init()` and `end_init()` nest. Stock property events remain synchronous outside initialization and coalesce by event identity inside it; the final payloads publish in first-event order after the outer commit, and `initialization_completed` reports the combined dirty flags.

Subclass hooks `measure`, `arrange`, `on_paint`, `visual_outsets`, `hit_test_local`, the pointer/key/text/drag route hooks, focus notification, and `on_activate` define a custom control. Drawing uses the renderer-neutral `Painter` vocabulary.
Portable coordinate conversion terminates at Window client coordinates; a native desktop-screen origin remains host-contract work.
gui_forms::Control.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::Control.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::Control.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
